plan.title: Live RFQ Edit Evaluation Time Window

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects required for the live RFQ.
Apply the required tenant configuration for the event menu.
Apply the required live-event withdrawal configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings action that should display the evaluation-time dialog.
Assert that the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
Verify the dialog includes the evaluation-duration option.
Verify the dialog includes the evaluation-ending-time option.
Verify the dialog provides a Cancel button without pressing it.
Verify the dialog provides an Ok button without pressing it.
